note: _per nomen externorum deorum non iurabilis_. Instead of _iurabilis_, one would expect _commemorabilis_. What we have here is a specifically Jeromian interpretation. – Augustin Merk SJ: _Introductionis in S. Scripturae libros compendium._ Paris 1940 (xi, 1092 pp. in 2 vols.), tomus primus, p. 176.
